captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a cross-drilling mechanical vise mounted on a dual-axis sliding or swivel base. The entire structure is colored in a dark blue-gray steel material, except for the bright metallic silver guide rods, a central threaded leadscrew, and a black handle collar with a silver T-bar tipped with red spherical knobs. The upper assembly features two parallel V-block jaws designed to secure cylindrical workpieces. The front V-block jaw slides smoothly along two parallel round-bar guides, driven linearly by the central leadscrew handle, while the base plate can rotate or slide on its bottom mounting track.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a cross-drilling vise featuring a rectangular base plate, a fixed rear V-groove jaw, a movable front V-groove jaw sliding on two parallel cylindrical guide bars, and a central threaded leadscrew with a T-bar handle capped with red spherical knobs.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model using several parts: a base plate created with Box primitives and boolean slot cuts; two parallel guide rods modeled as Cylinder shapes; a central leadscrew created with a Cylinder and helical or ring sweeps; a fixed jaw and a sliding jaw, both extruded from custom 2D sketches to form V-grooves; and a T-handle assembly made of intersecting cylinders with spherical knobs at each end. Prismatic joint constraints are applied to the sliding jaw along the guide rods, and a revolute joint is defined for the central leadscrew.
